facts.claim: Meta was testing a “human concierge” for Muse in which human contractors handled some phone calls placed through the digital agent.
facts.subject: Muse human-concierge test
facts.date_or_period: Reported on 2026-09-23; the article's dateline is 2026-09-22. The test's exact start date is not stated.
facts.scope: Some phone calls placed through Muse; the article does not specify the number or proportion of calls handled by contractors.
facts.conditions: The contractors handled calls as part of the test.
facts.source_title: Exclusive-Meta testing a 'human concierge' for its new personal AI agent, Muse (Reuters via CNA)
facts.ambiguity: The article does not specify how many calls or what proportion of Muse calls were handled by contractors.
facts.notes_for_writer: Reuters attributes the account to internal company posts it reviewed. Do not imply that all Muse calls were handled by humans.
facts.context: The test concerned Muse's phone-calling feature.

facts.claim: Meta enabled the human-concierge feature, also called “human agent calls,” for half of its employees.

facts.numeric_scope: Meta employees, as described in the internal posts; not Muse users or calls.
facts.source_title: Exclusive-Meta testing a 'human concierge' for its new personal AI agent, Muse (Reuters via CNA)
facts.ambiguity: The article uses “half of its employees” without providing the employee population or exact dates.
facts.notes_for_writer: Keep the denominator as employees; do not recast this as half of Muse users or half of calls.
facts.context: The internal posts described the feature as a way to have a trained agent place calls and work through requests.

facts.ambiguity: No sample size, measurement method, or exact AI-calling success rate is provided. “Lower percentage” is not quantified.
facts.notes_for_writer: Attribute this comparison to the vice president and preserve the qualification that some tests indicated the range. Do not present 95%–98% as a general or independently verified rate.
facts.actor: A vice president in Meta's Superintelligence Labs unit
